title: Right Turn on Red
humanBehavior: Human drivers typically inch forward slowly, glancing for cross-traffic and pedestrians, and may roll through if it looks clear.
avHandling: The platform comes to a complete stop behind the limit line, uses sensors to verify no crossing pedestrians or approaching cross-traffic exist, and proceeds only when its computed trajectory is clear.

title: Four-Way Stops
humanBehavior: Human drivers rely on eye contact and social cues to determine who arrived first and who goes next.
avHandling: The platform tracks the arrival time of every vehicle at the intersection and strictly adheres to first-to-arrive right-of-way rules, proceeding when its turn safely opens.

title: School Buses
humanBehavior: Human drivers often slow down near buses but might occasionally miss flashing red lights or stop signs until the last moment.
avHandling: The platform is programmed to immediately recognize a stopped school bus with activated flashing lights or extended stop sign and will come to a complete halt, maintaining a safe distance until the signals are deactivated.

title: Jaywalking Pedestrians
humanBehavior: Human drivers might not notice pedestrians crossing mid-block, especially at night or in busy areas, leading to sudden braking.
avHandling: The platform continuously scans a 360-degree perimeter and detects pedestrians stepping into the roadway mid-block, proactively adjusting its speed or stopping entirely to yield right-of-way and prevent an incident.

title: Aggressive Lane Changes
humanBehavior: Human drivers often swerve abruptly or fail to signal, relying on others to brake to avoid collisions.
avHandling: The platform anticipates sudden cut-ins by monitoring neighboring vehicle trajectories and maintains a dynamic safety buffer, smoothly decelerating if another vehicle aggressively enters its lane.

title: Zipper Merging
humanBehavior: Human drivers may hesitate or assert dominance when lanes merge, leading to unpredictable traffic flow and bottlenecks.
avHandling: The platform computes the optimal interleaving sequence and adjusts its speed smoothly to create space or merge seamlessly into the flow, maximizing efficiency and safety.

title: Unprotected Left Turns
humanBehavior: Human drivers must estimate the speed and distance of oncoming traffic, occasionally misjudging and causing near-misses.
avHandling: The platform utilizes precise depth and velocity tracking of all oncoming traffic to calculate exact time-to-collision windows, executing the turn only when the margin is mathematically secure.

title: Railroad Crossings
humanBehavior: Human drivers often glance quickly or ignore passive signals if they assume a train isn't coming.
avHandling: The platform recognizes both active and passive crossing signals, coming to a required stop if signals are active, and ensuring clear sensor visibility before crossing any tracks.
